location: Homeless camps in woods, 1300 block of Lankford Drive
title: Man dies, woman badly burned in arson at homeless camps
summary: Police reported fires were set at two homeless camps around 7 a.m. A 35-year-old man died of burns and a 37-year-old woman was seriously burned. The suspect had allegedly argued with and threatened the victims.
status: Charged: Grady Callaway, 53 — malice murder, aggravated assault, two counts aggravated battery, two counts arson, animal cruelty (allegations; disposition not verified)
alsoCovered: Valdosta Today; Valdosta Daily Times 8/05; Lanier County News 8/06
